newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo Nobel JV buys peroxides business.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel JV buys peroxides business.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Wednesday its 50 percent owned Japanese venture Kayaku Akzo Co (KAC) had aquired the organic peroxides business of Sanken Chemical Corp Ltd for an undisclosed sum.
The deal, which has been approved by the Japanese authorities, is retroactive from June 1, 1997, Akzo Nobel said.
KAC is a producer of organic peroxides. The other half of the joint venture is owned by Nippon Kayaku Ltd.
Akzo Nobel said the acquisition further strengthened its position in the market for organic peroxides, which are supplied to polymer makers.

Akzo Nobel produces chemicals for the polymer industry in fully-owned plants in Europe, the U.S., Mexico and Brazil and via two joint ventures in Japan and one in India. Another joint venture in China recently came on stream.
